verdict.rationale: Forter's marketing copy explicitly claims to 'Stop ATO, block fake accounts, protect account integrity' alongside its checkout/fraud-decision APIs, indicating account-takeover and fake-account protection live in the same platform as order-level fraud scoring. However, there is no documentation of promo abuse or policy abuse detection/management, and no detail on how ATO/fake-account signals are scored or surfaced to analysts beyond a single marketing line. Missing for 10: dedicated docs/API for promo abuse and policy abuse detection, analyst-facing workflow/management details for ATO and fake-account cases beyond marketing claims.
